text:
Sam (Marketing): Morning — quick async standup for the campaign push. What I did: final copy pass on benchmark blog, uploaded hero images to CDN. Blockers: need a quick CR on the benchmark results panel, and the landing page hero still needs the alt text. Today: finish the launch checklist, coordinate with eng for the staged rollout @Jonas @Ben :rocket:

Priya (PM): Thanks Sam. I'm good on copy QA. Blocker: legal asked for one tiny phrasing tweak on the footer — will drop a comment in the doc. For rollout window, aiming for 10:30am PT. @Maya can you confirm the hero variants for A/B? :eyes:

Maya (Design): Confirmed — V1 and V2 live in the assets folder. V2 has slightly larger CTA. Uploaded optimized SVGs at /assets/campaign/hero-v2.svg. No blockers from design. Leaving a note about alt text to Sam.

Jonas (Eng): Saw the PRs. Quick status: PR #482 (landing page HTML) is in review, needs one accessibility nit fixed. PR #485 (benchmark visualization) has a failing test — looks like locale float formatting. I'll dig in after standup. Can we hold full rollout until both PRs merge?

Sam (Marketing): @Jonas yep, holding rollout is fine. Can you ping when PR #485 is green? Also need a small endpoint from infra to fetch the latest benchmark JSON for the blog embed — should be lightweight.

Ben (Eng-Infra): I can spin up a short-lived signed URL endpoint for the blog embed. Will add a tiny proxy at /_internal/bench/latest.json. ETA 30-45m. Note: needs a vault token; I'll use a read-only key and rotate after launch.

Jonas (Eng): Update: PR #485 fixed (locale issue). Running CI again. If green, I'll merge and then do a quick smoke on staging.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: campaign-preview -> staging at 1851234700 by @Jonas. Status: queued.

Sam (Marketing): Nice. Quick QA ask for reviewers: please prioritize the landing CRs — @Jonas left one a11y nit in #482, and #485 once green needs a thumbs from @Priya and @Maya for visual/verbiage.

Priya (PM): Will review #485 after breakfast. If green, we can target the 10:30am PT window.

Maya (Design): I'll review visual diff on staging once deploy finishes. Heads up: verify CTA contrast on mobile.

Jonas (Eng): CI passed, merged #485 and #482. Kicked staging deploy. Will post when smoke test completes.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: campaign-preview -> staging at 1851234720. Logs available at https://deploys.internal/redwood/campaign-preview

Ben (Eng-Infra): Proxy endpoint up: https://staging.internal/_internal/bench/latest.json — throttled to 5r/s. Let me know if you need different TTL on the object.

Sam (Marketing): Verified embed pulling correct JSON. Quick ask: please leave the signed token valid until 12pm PT, then rotate.

Jonas (Eng): Smoke test passed on staging. Visuals look good on desktop and mobile. CTA contrast check ok.

Priya (PM): Great — proceeding with soft rollout at 10:30am PT. Sam, finalize the tracking tags and the bench note copy. Maya, hold on a final visual check right before rollout.

Maya (Design): Will do a last pass at +5 mins before rollout.

Sam (Marketing): Done — tracking tags in place, bench note published in CMS draft and set to go live with rollout. Thanks everyone. If anyone spots anything odd once soft rollout starts ping here or DM. :thumbsup:

Jonas (Eng): After rollout, I'll watch error rate and latency for the embed endpoint. If anything spikes, we'll roll back to canary.

Ben (Eng-Infra): I'll monitor infra metrics and rotate the token at 12pm PT as requested.

Priya (PM): Closing the loop — thanks team. If no issues, we'll schedule the full public push at 2pm PT.

Sam (Marketing): Copy. Will post a quick launch recap in #marketing once public. :tada:
